text: The UEBA system flagged AGW1590's activity for the week of 2011-W10 due to evidence of elevated file copying to removable media and overall activity volume significantly above their peer distribution. Specifically, AGW1590 copied 12 files to removable media, which is above their typical range of 3 and the highest in the prior 12 weeks of 13. Additionally, their file operations totalled 34, which is far above their typical range of 14 and the highest in the prior 12 weeks of 28, and also significantly above the peer range of 1 across 328 peers in this role.
